subject: Android (operating system)
prompt: Google's open-source mobile operating system, built for touchscreen phones and tablets, runs on a modified version of which kernel?
why: Android is an open-source operating system developed by Google, based on a modified version of the Linux kernel and other free and open-source software, designed primarily for touchscreen mobile devices.

subject: Rothschild family
prompt: This Ashkenazi Jewish banking dynasty takes its name from the family house where its documented history begins in the 16th century. In which German city did it start?
why: The Rothschild family is a wealthy Ashkenazi Jewish noble banking family originally from Frankfurt, Germany. Its documented history starts in 16th-century Frankfurt, and its name derives from the family house, Rothschild.

subject: 2024 Men's T20 World Cup
prompt: Co-hosted by Cricket West Indies in June 2024, this was the first major ICC tournament to stage matches in which country?
why: The 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup was co-hosted by Cricket West Indies and USA Cricket from 1 to 29 June 2024, and was the first major ICC tournament to include matches played in the United States.

subject: United States dollar
prompt: The Coinage Act of 1792 divided the new American currency into 100 cents and set it at par with which existing coin?
why: The Coinage Act of 1792 introduced the U.S. dollar at par with the Spanish silver dollar, divided it into 100 cents, and authorized the minting of coins.

subject: COVID-19 pandemic
prompt: Caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, this global pandemic began with an outbreak in December 2019 in which Chinese city?
why: The global COVID-19 pandemic, caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), began with an outbreak in Wuhan, China, in December 2019, spreading worldwide in early 2020.

subject: Attack on Pearl Harbor
prompt: On 7 December 1941 Japan struck the United States Pacific Fleet at its naval base, then drawing a neutral country into the war. On which Hawaiian island was that base?
why: On December 7, 1941, the Empire of Japan launched a surprise strike on the United States Pacific Fleet at its naval base at Pearl Harbor on Oahu, Hawaii Territory, while the US was still a neutral country in World War II.

subject: 95th Academy Awards
prompt: Presented by AMPAS in March 2023 for the films of 2022, this ceremony was held at which Hollywood venue?
why: The 95th Academy Awards ceremony, presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, took place on March 12, 2023 at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, Los Angeles.

subject: Earthquake
prompt: Also called a quake, tremor or temblor, it is the shaking of the surface caused by a sudden release of energy — in which layer of the Earth?
why: An earthquake is the shaking of the Earth's surface resulting from a sudden release of energy in the lithosphere that creates seismic waves.

subject: Industrial Revolution
prompt: Sometimes called the First of its name to distinguish it from a later one, this shift toward widespread mechanised manufacturing is usually dated to roughly which span?
why: The Industrial Revolution, sometimes called the First Industrial Revolution in contrast to the subsequent Second Industrial Revolution, was a transitional period of the global economy toward more widespread, efficient and stable manufacturing, dated roughly 1760-1840.

prompt: Adding or subtracting this number leaves any other number unchanged. In mathematical terms it is the additive what, of the integers and the reals?
why: 0 is a number representing an empty quantity. Adding or subtracting 0 to any number leaves that number unchanged; in mathematical terminology 0 is the additive identity of the integers, rational numbers, real numbers and complex numbers.
